# killfeed

<!-- GENERATED by `python -m uikit docs` from contracts/killfeed.json - do not edit by hand. -->

Server-wide feed, newest on top. A pool of rows; entries shift down.

C#: `KillFeedLayout / IKillFeedService`

Marker: `<!-- uikit:killfeed rows=5 -->`

Pool parameters (marker and C# layout descriptor must agree):

- `rows` (default `5`): Rows in the pool (KillFeedLayout.Rows), row 0 on top.

Placeholders: `{n}` = each of `rows`.

| Element | Kind | Required | Kit writes | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id="kf_{n}"` | panel | yes | `hidden`, `style-*`, `flash-a`, `flash-b` | A row. Author it `hidden`. Row 0 alternates `flash-a`/`flash-b` on each push: give both the same entry animation. |
| `id="kf_{n}_attacker"` | panel | no | `empty` | Label of the attacker, `empty` when blank. |
| `id="kf_{n}_tag"` | panel | no | `empty` | Label of the tag, `empty` when blank. |
| `text="{s:kf_{n}_victim}"` | Label text | yes | string | KillFeedEntry.Victim |
| `text="{s:kf_{n}_attacker}"` | Label text | no | string | KillFeedEntry.Attacker |
| `text="{s:kf_{n}_tag}"` | Label text | no | string | KillFeedEntry.Tag |
| `text="{s:kf_{n}_<key>}"` | Label text | no | string | KillFeedEntry.Texts[key] |
